title: Remediated fixture usability and visual baseline acknowledgement

proposed_delta_on_pass.description: Acknowledge the remediated fixture-only console as the initial usable visual baseline and permit RCN-WP4 preparation only.
permits: RCN-WP4 preparation within the approved plan
continued fixture-only presentation work and evidence preparation
does_not_permit: governance writes beyond approved programme records
probability, risk, exposure or execution authority

acceptance_conditions: Operator judges the remediated fixture console to have materially converged toward the supplied visual direction and to be usable as the initial baseline.
The primary market/structure canvas is visually dominant while context navigation, evidence inspection, C2E timeline and bottom evidence conditions remain legible.
1920x1080, 1440x810 and 1280x720 layouts retain critical labels and usable hierarchy without overlapping core panels.
SYNTHETIC FIXTURE, NON-EVIDENTIARY and AUTHORITY EFFECT NONE remain persistent.
C2E absence is represented as NOT_MATERIALIZED with the source reason rather than substituted data.
Null/residual evidence remains explicit and is not promoted into a positive family claim.
AVAILABLE, AUTHORISED and ACTIVE remain visibly independent globally and at object scope.
Presentation interactions remain navigation/display only and cannot mutate evidence or authority.
warnings: This gate remains operator-reserved because it establishes the accepted visual/usability baseline.
Passing this gate does not expose real sources; RCN-G4 remains separately operator-required before any real-source route.
changed_files_summary: RCN-WP3C changed fixture-only presentation shell, responsive layout and evidence hierarchy; subsequent G3C receipt changes are administrative only.
rollback_on_defer_or_block: Keep RCN-WP3C merged as inactive fixture-only presentation capability, keep RCN-WP4 denied, and prepare only a bounded additional visual-remediation packet if directed by the operator.
exact_work_after_pass: Record operator RCN-G3V PASS, merge the gate decision/state record, create RCN-WP4 branch from latest lawful main, execute authorised WP4 preparation, and stop at operator-required RCN-G4 before any real-source exposure.
